bullets: Fixed macOS sponsored runs to resolve Apple's git shim before exec so in-sandbox git commits reach real git.
Improved the sponsored file layer to pin directories in-process instead of routing through an OS broker helper.
Added Windows path validation, case-insensitive resolution, and staged writes to the sponsored SDK file layer.
Added per-OS sponsored agentic switches for Windows and Linux desktop, with bwrap required for Linux capability.
Caught synchronous spawn throws in SDK git helper so a cmd.exe-special-character git shim fails gracefully.
Accepted null name from login responses and print Logged in as ${email} when no name is present.
Swapped the /chat thinker child to GPT-6 Luna and withdrew GPT-5.6 Luna from free model id constants.
Sanitized and hashed MCP tool names so dots spaces slashes or colons no longer fail the turn.
Treated accepted FirstMessage CAPI status as delivered and skipped to stop duplicate sends.
Classified the report_project_profile tool as an agent control capability.
Defined agentic offer route wire contract with path route version request and response schemas.
Refreshed provisioned model ids and roots and retired extended-context internal-eval model rows.
Shared the env-template matcher for sponsored writes and outcome checks across read and write paths.
Added helper process census and watchdog inspection to refuse flooding and outlived-parent events.
